notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separately manipulated upper-cabinet doors and two separate drawers. The two cabinet-door closures occur close together between frames 312 and 328, so their individual ordering and midpoint estimates are less certain.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, then opens the top drawers on the left and right sides of the stove. The cabinet doors and drawers are later closed in separate manipulation episodes.
